learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to describe the basic structure of reciprocating machines and define their function-relevant components.
Students are able to evaluate the thermodynamic and fluid dynamic influences on the operational behavior of these machines as well as on important key figures and efficiencies.
Students are able to characterize or determine the most important process parameters of energy conversion machines and apply design tools for dimensioning.
Students are able to independently solve the tasks and problems arising during the basic design of reciprocating and rotary piston machines.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the field of reciprocating machines

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (90 min.) consisting of short questions and calculation part

assessment_rules: Depending on the number of participants, the examination will be either a written exam (90 min.) consisting of short questions and a calculation part, or an oral examination. The module grade is 100% based on this assessment.
bibliography: Küttner, Karl-Heinz: Kolbenmaschinen, Teubner: Stuttgart (6. neubearb. und erweit. Auflage) 1993.
